The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the construction company against the Award dated 30.03.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal / District Judge, Uttarkashi in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.5 of 2019, by which the learned Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs.5,90,000/- as compensation along with an interest at the rate 6% per annum.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claim Petition No.5 of 2019
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. Harshit Sanwal, learned counsel for the appellant.
3.
Mr. Harshit Sanwal, Advocate contended that the deceased was working as a Helper at JCB machine bearing registration no. HR-68B-7828.
The owner of the said JCB machine was respondent no.5.
The said vehicle fell into a ditch on 30.09.2015.

The appellant is a construction company,
which was constructing the motor road as per the contract, hence, liability cannot be imposed on the appellant company.
Issue notice to respondent no. 1, respondent no.2 and respondent nos.4 to 6.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Heard on the Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2024).

8. Mr. Harshit Sanwal, Advocate has sought four weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.7,00,000/-
(Rupees Seven Lakh) before the Tribunal.

9. Subject to depositing of Rs. 7,00,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakh), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 30.03.2024 are stayed till further order.
AO/203/2024 on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2936349/
1 10. Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2024) is disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 12.08.2024 Shiv/
